_comment: Every item type in the game. Values are in shards. The key (e.g. short_sword) is the id used in player.json and map files. kind is one of: weapon, armor, consumable, material, treasure, key, artifact, misc. properties is free-form, for game rules to read later. A weapon's calling is the middle name it gives a Hunter who wields it (Ylfa Fencer Hunters).

short_sword.name: short sword
short_sword.description: A plain, serviceable blade. Guild issue.

arming_sword.name: arming sword
arming_sword.description: A proper sword, well balanced. Sold by the supplier.

war_pick.name: war pick
war_pick.description: A heavy spike on a haft. Punches through hide and shell.

short_bow.name: short bow
short_bow.description: A short bow of horn and wood. Fire it with f; it needs arrows. Up close it's only good for a bash (1d2, plus 1 for every 6 Physicality).

longbow.name: longbow
longbow.description: A tall bow that takes a strong arm to draw. Fire it with f; it needs arrows. Up close it's only good for a bash (1d2, plus 1 for every 6 Physicality).

arrow.name: arrow
arrow.description: A fletched arrow. Shot, it may survive to be picked up again.

leather_jerkin.name: leather jerkin
leather_jerkin.description: Stiff boiled leather. Better than nothing.

mail_shirt.name: mail shirt
mail_shirt.description: Interlocked iron rings. Heavy, and worth it.

healing_draught.name: healing draught
healing_draught.description: Bitter and red. Closes small wounds.

healing_tonic.name: healing tonic
healing_tonic.description: A thicker, sweeter brew than the draught. Mends deeper wounds.

ration.name: ration
ration.description: Hard bread and harder cheese. Eaten, it mends you slowly: 1 HP a turn for 10 turns.

bandage.name: bandage
bandage.description: Clean linen. Use it (u) to stop bleeding; with Medicine rank 2, to bind up a minor injury so it mends at once. It doesn't always work (Medicine).

poultice.name: poultice
poultice.description: Crushed leaves in a cloth. It smells bitter. Use it (u) to draw out poison. It doesn't always work (Medicine).

torch.name: torch
torch.description: Pitch-soaked wood. Light it (u) for a little more light in dark places, for 300 turns. Needs no Jodebris.

rope.name: coil of rope
rope.description: Fifty feet of hemp, knotted for climbing. On a hunt, use it (u) to make your way straight back to the trail home.

old_key.name: old iron key
old_key.description: Heavy and rust-flecked. It must open something.

_materials: Materials: left by creatures when they die (data/monsters.json drops), used to commission gear (data/recipes.json), or sold. PLACEHOLDERS.

rough_hide.name: rough hide
rough_hide.description: A tough, uncured hide. A smith can make something of it.

thick_hide.name: thick hide
thick_hide.description: A heavy hide, bristled and hard to cut.

chitin_plate.name: chitin plate
chitin_plate.description: A curved plate of shell, light and hard.

sinew.name: sinew
sinew.description: Strong cord taken from something that no longer needs it.

sentinel_stone.name: sentinel stone
sentinel_stone.description: A fist of dense, fitted stone from a fallen sentinel. Heavier than it looks.

_crafted: Gear a smith makes to order (data/recipes.json). PLACEHOLDERS.

hide_jerkin.name: hide jerkin
hide_jerkin.description: Layers of cured hide, stitched tight.

thornback_coat.name: thornback coat
thornback_coat.description: A long coat of thick hide, the bristles left on the shoulders.

chitin_plate_armor.name: chitin armour
chitin_plate_armor.description: Overlapping shell plates on a sinew harness. Light for what it stops.

sinew_bow.name: sinew bow
sinew_bow.description: A recurved bow backed with sinew. Fire it with f; it needs arrows. Up close it's only good for a bash (1d2, plus 1 for every 6 Physicality).

iron_shod_axe.name: iron-shod axe
iron_shod_axe.description: A heavy axe, its head reworked from scrap iron.

sentinel_maul.name: sentinel maul
sentinel_maul.description: A maul with a head of sentinel stone. Slow to swing; terrible when it lands.

_artifacts: Tower Artifacts. PLACEHOLDER names, descriptions and effects. A broken artifact has: rarity (see rarities.json), appearance (what you see before identifying it: a name and description shared by several artifacts), repairs_to (the working artifact's id) and value (what the WORKING artifact sells for). Glyph and colour come from the rarity. Working artifacts: properties light (sight and torchlight, in dark places; the strongest one counts), armor, accuracy, evasion (while carried), and use: reveal (map the area) or heal N, uses_per_hunt. Out in the miasma, working artifacts only work while an equipped windcatcher has Jodebris left.

cracked_lens.name: cracked lens
cracked_lens.description: A thick disc of ground glass, split clean across. Held to the eye, it seems to gather light.

shattered_bell.name: shattered bell
shattered_bell.description: Three pieces of a small bell. They hum faintly when held together.

broken_astrolabe.name: broken astrolabe
broken_astrolabe.description: Brass rings, bent and seized. One plate is missing.

rusted_mechanism.name: rusted mechanism
rusted_mechanism.description: Gears and springs fused by rust into a single lump. Something inside is warm.

clouded_prism.name: clouded prism
clouded_prism.description: A long prism gone milky and chipped. Light goes in and doesn't come out.

seized_gyroscope.name: seized gyroscope
seized_gyroscope.description: Nested gimbals locked at odd angles. It always settles the same way up.

split_tuning_fork.name: split tuning fork
split_tuning_fork.description: A fork of pale metal, one tine cracked to the root. Your hand twitches when you hold it.

broken_reliquary.name: broken reliquary
broken_reliquary.description: A stone case, its lid sheared off. The hollow inside is heart-shaped.

fractured_orrery.name: fractured orrery
fractured_orrery.description: Dozens of tiny spheres on bent arms, most of them missing. The pattern looks like a map.

black_mirror.name: black mirror
black_mirror.description: A hand mirror of dark glass, crazed with cracks. Your reflection is a moment late.

nameless_relic.name: nameless relic
nameless_relic.description: A palm-sized stone set with glass, worn smooth. Nothing else like it is known.

_windcatchers: Windcatchers: artifacts that store Jodebris (the Chorus Winds) so other artifacts work out in the miasma. Broken ones look like any glass artifact. PLACEHOLDER names and numbers.

cracked_windcatcher.name: cracked windcatcher
cracked_windcatcher.description: A cage of fine wire around a bulb of thin glass, cracked through. Faint wind stirs inside it.

shattered_windcatcher.name: shattered windcatcher
shattered_windcatcher.description: A tall windcatcher, its glass in pieces but every piece still in the frame.

ruined_great_windcatcher.name: ruined great windcatcher
ruined_great_windcatcher.description: A windcatcher the size of a lantern, the glass clouded and holed. It sings when you breathe on it.

_working: Repaired Tower Artifacts. Only Artificers make these (by repairing the broken ones above).

lesser_windcatcher.name: lesser windcatcher
lesser_windcatcher.description: A small cage of wire and glass, humming with stored Jodebris.

great_windcatcher.name: great windcatcher
great_windcatcher.description: A great windcatcher, loud with wind.

glimmer_lens.name: glimmer lens
glimmer_lens.description: The lens, mended. It gathers light: you see further in dark places.

warding_chime.name: warding chime
warding_chime.description: The bell, whole again. Its faint hum turns aside a little of every blow.

wayfinder_astrolabe.name: wayfinder astrolabe
wayfinder_astrolabe.description: The rings turn freely now. Used, it shows you the shape of the place you're in.

mending_engine.name: mending engine
mending_engine.description: Wound and ticking. Pressed to a wound, its warmth closes it.

far_sight_prism.name: far-sight prism
far_sight_prism.description: Clear as water now. Darkness thins wherever you look.

steadying_gyre.name: steadying gyre
steadying_gyre.description: The gimbals spin true. Your hand is steadier while you carry it.

resonant_fork.name: resonant fork
resonant_fork.description: Both tines ring together. You move a moment before you need to.

heartstone.name: heartstone
heartstone.description: The reliquary, sealed and beating. It can pull you back from the edge.

great_orrery.name: great orrery
great_orrery.description: Every sphere in place and turning. It maps wherever you stand.

lantern_mirror.name: lantern mirror
lantern_mirror.description: The dark glass glows from within, and your reflection keeps pace again.

nameless_relic_working.name: nameless relic (restored)
nameless_relic_working.description: Restored, it hums with something like attention. Nobody can say what it is for.

shard.name: shard
shard.description: The coin of the realm. The first shards were true pieces of Windcatcher glass.

selda.name: Selda Fencer Hunters
selda.description: Selda, hurt and too weak to walk far, an arm over your shoulders. She takes room you'd otherwise fill. Get her to the trail home (or use rope).

spent_torch.name: spent torch
spent_torch.description: Burned down to the grip. Someone out here was relying on torches: whatever lit their way before had stopped.

butchered_remains.name: butchered remains
butchered_remains.description: A pale lurker, opened with a practised hand where it fell: the hide and sinew taken, the rest left. Whoever did this knew how, and needed what they took.

selda_notes.name: Selda's field notes
selda_notes.description: A Hunter's notebook in a careful hand: creatures seen, turnings taken, how much light was left. The last entries get shorter. The guild clerk would want these.

selda_relic.name: nameless thing
selda_relic.description: Nobody can say what this is.
